mil3.7.14:0.3: 14. The Question on Dividing Small Things
mil3.7.14:1.2: “Sir Nagasena, can everything subtle be cut”?
mil3.7.14:1.3: “Yes, Great King, everything subtle can be cut”.
mil3.7.14:1.5: “The Dhamma, Great King, is all-subtle; not all qualities, Great King, are subtle. ‘Subtle’, ‘gross’: that is the designation for qualities
mil3.7.14:1.6: Whatever is to be cut, all of it is cut by understanding; there is no cutting by a second kind of understanding”.
mil3.7.14:3.1: The Question on Dividing Small Things, fourteenth.
